description: Hand-written responses for case cross-file-units, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: requestTimeout now returns milliseconds but callUpstream still multiplies by 1000
findings.description: callUpstream (unchanged) computes requestTimeout(process.env) * 1000, so the default timeout becomes 30,000,000 ms (over 8 hours).
findings.impact: Hung upstream calls are never aborted in practice; requests pile up.

evidence.why: The caller converts seconds to milliseconds.

findings.suggestedFix: Remove the * 1000 in callUpstream, or keep requestTimeout in seconds.

reasons: Scripted verdict: the cited code shows the problem.
